verdict.rationale: Phaser is documented as an npm dependency (`npm install phaser`), and a runtime probe confirms it is published on npm (v4.2.1, MIT, ~263k weekly downloads). It ships TypeScript definitions that editors detect automatically, and the docs claim support for over 40 front-end frameworks, which suggests it fits into existing toolchains. Missing for 10: any evidence of tree-shaking or ES-module granularity, explicit bundler integration docs (e.g. Vite/webpack), and hands-on corroboration of importing and bundling it.
